mapper.select: SELECT p.*, c.name AS c_name, b.name AS b_name FROM product p LEFT JOIN category c ON p.category_id = c.id LEFT JOIN brand b ON p.brand_id = b.id ORDER BY p.id

SELECT p.*, c.name AS c_name, b.name AS b_name FROM product p LEFT JOIN category c ON p.category_id = c.id LEFT JOIN brand b ON p.brand_id = b.id WHERE p.name LIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' ORDER BY p.id
SELECT p.*, c.name AS c_name, b.name AS b_name FROM product p LEFT JOIN category c ON p.category_id = c.id LEFT JOIN brand b ON p.brand_id = b.id WHERE p.id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO product (name, price, stock, category_id, brand_id, description) VALUES (#{name}, #{price}, #{stock}, #{categoryId}, #{brandId}, #{description})
